subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Anansi the Spider
description: A fast breakdown of Anansi the Spider for builders.

hook.text: Anansi is a tiny spider who outwits gods, leopards, and pythons. In West Africa, he owns all the stories.

buildup.text: Nyame, the sky god, hoarded every story. Anansi bargained to buy them by completing impossible tasks.

discovery.text: He captured a python by tricking it into measuring itself with a stick. Cleverness beats size every time.

twist.text: Anansi won all stories. That's why West African folktales are called 'Anansi stories.' He owns narrative itself.

climax.text: Enslaved Africans carried Anansi to the Caribbean. The trickster survived the Middle Passage in stories.

punchline.text: A spider conquered a god—with words.

quiz.question: What did Anansi win from the sky god Nyame?
